Nesma & Partners / SICIM JV EPC contract awards for Jafurah Phase II and MGS Phase III (July 2024), covering gas compression facilities and associated export pipelines.

candidates.why_maybe_new: No 'Jafurah' pipeline exists anywhere in the SA gas roster. This is the dedicated ~349 km sales-gas export/transmission line from the Jafurah unconventional gas plant into the national grid, a distinct EPC package (Jafurah Field Development, not MGS-3). It is physically and contractually separate from the MGS III corridor segments already captured (P5885 network + P6717-P6737 EWPS lines) and from the 320 km Riyas NGL line (NGL, GOIT-scope). Could conceivably be folded into the MGS III network entry P5885 by the consolidator, but it is its own line with its own length/endpoints and belongs to the Jafurah development program. Status uncertain: DMS lists 'Completed' and Jafurah Phase 1 plant came onstream Dec 2025, so likely operating, but a line-specific commissioning date is not independently confirmed.
